name: lp
exec: (()=>{const T=window.THREE,S=window.__app.scene;const hit=(p,d)=>{const rc=new T.Raycaster(new T.Vector3(...p),new T.Vector3(...d));const h=rc.intersectObjects(S.children,true).filter(x=>x.object.name.startsWith('main'));return h.slice(0,2).map(x=>x.object.name.replace('main:','')+'@'+x.distance.toFixed(1)+' (z'+x.point.z.toFixed(1)+')').join(' | ')||'OPEN';};const o=[];for(const x of [-92,-90,-88,-86,-84,-82]){o.push('from x='+x+' toward +Z: '+hit([x,1.6,9.4],[0,0,1]));}return JSON.stringify(o)})()
